Warm calls: medians of 30 timed calls after 5 warm-up calls, in milliseconds, for a batch of 4 paths with 16 increments. Wordwise and JAX calls are compiled with `jax.jit` and alternate; the automatic call is the public function called eagerly. The ratio is the wordwise median divided by the JAX median, with its paired bootstrap 95% interval; below 1 the wordwise kernel is faster. The error is the largest absolute difference from the JAX result. The gate passes when the wordwise median is at least 20% below the JAX median and the upper end of the interval is at least 10% below 1.
